description: **Migrate forge's Claude Code hooks to function hooks (hooks-module) when upstream lands.** Anthropic's "Function Hooks: Core Architecture" (Aug 2026) adds a fifth hook type: `hooks/hooks.json` names `"modules"`, a TS/JS file whose `register(on)` installs Koa-style `($, e, next)` middleware; plugin order is authority, `$` is the only I/O door, `ui.render` is hookable. Code already present in Claude Code 2.1.280 (strings `no hooks module to load; hooks/hooks.json names none in "modules"`). Scope: canon-guard, stratum session/stop/tool-failure hooks, HOOK-CACHE read-cache, COMP-LOOP-DETECT, and the SDK-only telemetry in `server/agent-hooks.js`. Load-bearing constraints: keep decision logic host-neutral in `lib/` (Codex host must keep working), preserve canon-guard's fail-open and deny-wins semantics under order-is-authority, and keep the shell-hook path as fallback until the module path is proven. Trigger: upstream GA. See design.md.

links.note: canon-guard migrates in Phase 3; must keep fail-open + deny guarantees under order-is-authority
